Total revenue across all six channels from September 2025 to August 2026 was **₹912.5 Cr**. November 2025 was the highest month. August 2026 looks incomplete, so treat it with care.

**Monthly revenue (₹ Cr)**

| Month | Platform | D2C | QComm | Offline | International | Cafe | **Total** |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Sep 2025 | 12.71 | 9.82 | 8.22 | 5.12 | 4.86 | 2.91 | **43.64** |
| Oct 2025 | 33.79 | 26.09 | 21.90 | 13.59 | 12.93 | 7.75 | **116.05** |
| Nov 2025 | 36.20 | 27.90 | 23.42 | 14.50 | 13.81 | 8.29 | **124.13** |
| Dec 2025 | 26.14 | 20.17 | 16.91 | 10.49 | 9.98 | 5.99 | **89.67** |
| Jan 2026 | 15.44 | 11.93 | 9.99 | 6.19 | 5.90 | 3.53 | **52.98** |
| Feb 2026 | 13.42 | 10.38 | 8.69 | 5.38 | 5.13 | 3.08 | **46.07** |
| Mar 2026 | 23.81 | 18.38 | 15.44 | 9.56 | 9.10 | 5.45 | **81.75** |
| Apr 2026 | 22.84 | 17.60 | 14.77 | 9.16 | 8.70 | 5.23 | **78.29** |
| May 2026 | 24.11 | 18.63 | 15.65 | 9.70 | 9.22 | 5.53 | **82.85** |
| Jun 2026 | 22.79 | 17.60 | 14.78 | 9.15 | 8.71 | 5.22 | **78.26** |
| Jul 2026 | 31.18 | 24.05 | 20.18 | 12.49 | 11.90 | 7.14 | **106.93** |
| Aug 2026 ⚠️ | 3.46 | 2.68 | 2.24 | 1.39 | 1.33 | 0.79 | **11.89** |
| **Total** | | | | | | | **912.5** |

**What stands out:**
- **October–November 2025 was the peak**, at ₹116–124 Cr a month. It rose in late September and peaked in the weeks of 16 and 23 November.
- **January–February 2026 was the low point**, at about ₹46–53 Cr. Revenue came back to about ₹78–83 Cr a month from March to June, then rose to ₹107 Cr in July.
- **Each channel's share barely changes from month to month.** Platform is about 29%, D2C about 22%, QComm about 19%, Offline about 12%, International about 11% and Cafe about 6.5%.
- **⚠️ August 2026 data is probably incomplete.** The data runs to 31 August, but daily sales lines fall from about 30,000 to about 110 after the first week of August. Don't read that month as a real 89% drop until the data load has been checked.
- **September 2025 is genuinely low, not missing data.** Its weekly figures match August 2025 (about ₹10.3 Cr a week) before the late-September rise.

**How it was calculated:** I used the `sales.revenue_inr` measure from the semantic layer. It is the company's standard revenue definition and combines all six channel order tables. International sales are converted at 83 INR/USD. All order statuses are included, and soft-deleted rows are left out. Months are based on `order_date_key`.
